name: touch_top_bar
description: top_bar=touch at a phone-like window (1584x720, canvas scale 0.9375): a tap on Resources opens the compact panel, a second tap closes it, a tap on Menu opens the M drop-down (the rows are finger-sized, the first is the game menu), a tap on its first row opens the game menu, and the area the classic bar covered is map (a click there does not open the old M drop-down)
